chapter.verse: Tu-in siahdongte leh mawhneite a vekun Jesu' thugen ngai dingin hong neh ngeingai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Pharisee-te leh laisiamte phun uh a, "Hih mipa in mawhneite kinbawlin amau tawh an nekhawm hi," ci uh hi.
Tua hangin Jesu in amaute' kiangah hih thugenteh gen hi:
"Note lakah tuu zakhat nei-in khat mansuah hileh tuu sawmkua-le-kuate gamlak lonona ah nusia-in tua a mang pen a muh dong a zong lo ding kua om na hi uh hiam?
Amah in tua tuu a muh ciangin lungdamin a liangko ah pua ding hi.
Inn a tun ciangin a lawmte leh a vengte samin amaute' kiangah, 'Kei tawh hong lungdamkhawm un. A hang pen a mangsa ka tuu ka mukik hi,' ci ding hi.
Tua dan mahin ke'n kong cihin ah kisik ding a kullo midik sawmkua-le-kuate' hanga nuamna sangin mawhnei mi khat a kisikna hangin vantung ah nuamna lianzaw ding hi.
"Ahihkeileh zong drachmaa tang sawm a neih lakah tang khat mansuah hileh meivak vakin inn sung teng phiatin a muhkik mateng limtak a zong lo ding numei kua om ahi hiam?
Amah in a muhkik ciangin a lawmte leh a vengte samin amaute' kiangah, 'Kei tawh hong lungdamkhawm un. A hang pen ka mansuahsa ka drachma tang ka mukik hi,' ci ding hi.
Ke'n kong cihin ah tua dan lian mahin mawhnei mi khat a kisikna hangin Pasian' vanmite' omna ah nuamna om hi."
Hih bangin zong gen lai hi: "Mi khat in Tapa nih nei hi.
A nauzawpa in a pa' kiangah, 'Pa aw, keima' luah ding gamh a kisehzah hong pia in,' ci hi. A pa in zong a neihsa teng a tate nih hawmsak hi.
Tua khit sauvei lo-in nauzawpa pen a neih khempeuh kaikhawmin gamdang gamlapi khat ah zinkhia a, tua lai-ah utut gamta nungta-in a neihsa teng thangzat hi.
A neih khempeuh a vekin a zatbei khit ciangin tua gam ah kialpi nasiatak tung a, amah zong kizatsam ta hi.
Tua ciangin tua lai-a gammite khat' kiangah sum thalawh dingin pai a, tua pa in a lo ah vok cing dingin sawl hi.
Vokte' nek begapte nangawn duhgawhin ne nuam a, ahi zongin kuamah in bangmah pia lo hi.
"Ahih hangin khua hong phawkkik a, 'Ka pa' kianga sum thalawh nasem tampite in anlum a khamval ding uh nei napi kei ka hihleh gilkialin a puksi ding hi tazen!
Kei tho-in ka pa' kiangah ka pai ding a, ama' kiangah, Pa aw, vantung leh nangma' tungah ka khial khinzo hi.
Na tapa cih dingin kilawm nawnlo ka hih manin sum thalawh nasemte khat bangin hong koih in," ka ci ding hi,' ci hi.
Tua hi a, amah tho-in a pa' kiangah ciah hi. Tua ciangin a pa in gamlapi pek pan na mu a, hehpihhuai sa ahih manin va delhin a tapa' ngawng kawi-in nam hi.
A tapa in a pa' kiangah, 'Pa aw, vantung leh nangma' tungah ka khial khinzo hi. Na tapa kicih ding ka kilawm nawn kei hi,' ci hi.
Ahih hangin a pa in a silate' kiangah, 'Kinawh sin uh! Puantual hoihpen hong la unla amah silhsak un. A khut ah khutbuh, a khe ah khedap bulhsak un.
Bawngno kivakthau pen hong la unla go un! Nekledawn bawlin gualnuam ni.
A hang pen hih ka tapa a si hong hingkik hi a, a mangthang a kimukik ahi hi,' ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute zong gualnop kipan uh hi.
"Tu-in a tapa uzaw pen lo kuan hi a, a ciahlam inn tun kuan ciangin tumging aw leh lamna huging za hi.
Tua ciangin amah in sawltangzangte khat samin a thu a la dong hi.
Sawltangzangpa in, 'Na sanggampa hong tung a, na pa in amah cidama a muhkik manin bawngno kivakthau a gawh ahi hi,' ci hi.
Ahih hangin uzawpa hehin inn sung lut nuamlo hi. A pa pusuakin uzawpa limtak zol hi.

Ahih hangin uzawpa in a pa dawng a, 'En in, kum hitanta nangma' na ka sem a, nong thupiakte zong mang lo-in ka om ngeikei hi. Hinapi, ka lawmte tawh gualnop ka bawl nadingin keelno khat nangawn nong pia ngeikei hi.
Ahih hangin numei kizuakte tawh na neihsa teng a netum hih na tapa hong tun ciangin bawngno kivakthau na gawh tazen hi!' ci hi.
Tua ciangin a pa in, 'Ka ta aw, nang pen kei tawh a omkhawm den na hi a, keima' neihsa khempeuh zong nangma' a mah ahi hi.
Hih na sanggampa ahihleh a si hong hingkik, a mangthang a kimukik ahih manin gualnuamin i lungdam ding a kilawm ahi hi,' ci-in gen hi."A Diktatlo Thuvanpa
